description: Two dozen amyls in a rattling little box. A brief, roaring rush.

overdose.message: One popper too many and your blood pressure bottoms out. You fold like a chair.

phases.comeup_message: A hot rush slams up the back of your neck and the room goes bright and loud.
phases.end_message: The rush drops out from under you as fast as it came.

effects.take_line: You crack an amyl under your nose and breathe in.

withdrawal.message: Your head has the shape of the rush left in it and none of the rush.

stages.easing: It comes down to the size of an ordinary bad head.
stages.onset: A band tightens across the front of your skull, in exactly the place the rush used to sit.
stages.peak: The headache is behind both eyes and moves when you move, and standing up has become something you plan first.
stages.rising: Your face is hot and your hands are cold and neither of them will trade.
stages.tail: Mostly gone. The band still arrives across the front of your skull for an hour most evenings.

name: amyls
